summary: Slovenia, engineering background, strong interest in technology and cybersecurity, critical of government policies, skeptical of mainstream media, advocates for privacy rights, engaged in discussions about social issues, supports progressive taxation, critical of corporate influence in politics, interested in open-source software, experienced in programming (especially Perl), concerned about the impact of immigration on local job markets, values personal accountability and transparency in governance, believes in the importance of education and standardized testing, critical of the handling of COVID-19 policies, advocates for individual freedoms and personal choice regarding health measures.
